scope: [이 발주에서 냄]; post-render diagnostic, no location/threshold selection or figure modification
method: At unchanged REGIONFIG bin centres where |prior-GT|>0.5m, intersect every unfiltered TSDF section segment with vertical bin line. Count whether any intersection is within 0.25m vertically of each input height. All multiple intersections retained; nearest does not establish same-surface correspondence. The 0.25m tolerance is an audit aid, not DIST71 tau or a scientific pass criterion.

viscmp_v1_overlap.method: 0.01m centreline sampling against exact XY footprints of V1 outlined 0.25m patches; no section relocation
